source_basis.atomic_obligation: An authorised provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.

obligation_elements.statement: Establish and operate complaint classification, escalation and remediation arrangements.
Maintain the framework through customer-outcomes oversight and periodic management-information review.

control_coverage_assertions.rationale: The control operates complaint classification, escalation and remediation.
The control does not provide the separate customer-outcomes oversight review.
Management-information review does not itself operate complaint handling.
The control provides ongoing customer-outcomes oversight and review.

evidence_requirements.expected: Approved framework or procedure identifying governance, ownership and review arrangements.
Completed complaint register or case records for the assessment period.
Complaint records contain no unresolved repeated high-impact operating exceptions.
Periodic customer-outcomes management information with review evidence.

human_review.decision_rationale: Approved as a synthetic operating rulebook derived from the approved obligation, source locator and frozen control design descriptions. It is not a legal interpretation or production control assessment.
